newsitem.title: USA: EchoStar looking for alternatives - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: EchoStar looking for alternatives - WSJ.

text.p: EchoStar Communications Corp has held discussions with investment banking firms and is seeking financial alternatives in the wake of its collapsed direct-broadcast TV deal with News Corp Ltd, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Monday's electronic edition, the Journal said EchoStar Chief Executive Charles Ergen is unfurling an emergency plan and is looking for alternatives to meet its short-term capital requirements.
The company also intends to seek a new strategic partner, the Journal said.
The details were part of court papers filed in federal court in Denver by EchoStar over its aborted venture with News Corp.

The deal collapsed last week only a few months after it was announced. The venture was to offer as many as 500 channels of digital TV, Internet services and local broadcast TV signals to markets across the United States.
